question: What restriction governs the height of the liṅga’s head portion?
premises: The head portion has a prescribed height relative to the liṅga.
A height other than what was stated is considered.
Making it other than stated is prohibited.
inference: One must not make the head’s height different from what has been prescribed for the liṅga.
plain_english: On the head, one should not make the liṅga’s height different from what has been stated.
